name: via-cam
description: via-cam: the 21 VIA tools + gripper_home (joint-space return to the start pose), camera_views (gallery of every selectable camera), camera_feed_select (sticky 3rd-person feed switch), and camera_raw (any single camera's frame at native render fidelity).
source: VIA (https://github.com/hengyuan-hu/via) ported onto the kernel, plus the camera tools; serves core/UI/index.html
